rules.source: Require the explicit modern Italianate Ecclesiastical source note; generic Ecclesiastical is insufficient to establish the selected regional convention.
rules.consonants: Italianate c/g before front vowels, sc/gn, ti contexts, v and gemination are supplied by the labelled dictionary reading, not obtained by relabelling Classical IPA.
rules.vowels: Retain dictionary vowel qualities and lengths; normalize only the shared IPA delimiters, syllable separators and stress. Do not equate Classical quantity with Italianate allophonic length.
rules.gaps: Exclude dictionary gaps. The old Classical converter is not an Italianate fallback; a new independently validated converter/version is required before gap filling.
rules.scope: A selected research assumption, not a reconstruction of uniform late-medieval Latin.

rules.source: Only explicitly Tiberian dictionary IPA; generic reconstructed Biblical, niqqud and ETCBC phono do not establish this convention.
rules.shewa: Preserve the supplied vocalic/silent shewa interpretation and its vowel quality. Bare consonants or shewa marks alone do not supply syllabic or contextual resolution.
rules.dagesh: Preserve supplied gemination and stop/fricative distinctions. Dagesh lene/forte and mappiq require morphological/syllabic context; do not infer them from an undifferentiated dot.
rules.begadkefat: Retain the six stop/fricative distinctions b/v, g/gh, d/dh, k/kh, p/f, t/th as actually represented in the source IPA, without Modern Hebrew substitution.
rules.gutturals: Retain source glottal/pharyngeal segments and context-conditioned reduced vowels. Do not delete gutturals or invent epenthetic vowels.
rules.vowels: Retain Tiberian vowel quality, reduction and quantity supplied by the source, including qamats/patah and tsere/segol distinctions; unsupported diacritics are exclusions.
rules.context: Any future spelling converter needs resolved qere/ketiv, full vocalization, syllable/stress context, shewa and dagesh interpretation, matres and word-boundary context. No such converter is asserted here.
rules.bhsa: BHSA remains optional, non-commercial and unbundled; old BHSA outputs are join targets only, never Tiberian pronunciation references or candidate IPA.

rules.source: Classical source classification is required independently of vocalization; MSA/dialect and unclassified Arabic are not substitutes.
rules.citation: Keep the citation form exactly as supplied, including explicit final vowels and tanwin. Do not supply missing case endings, strip explicit endings, or generate a pausal alternative.
rules.vowels: Require an explicit short vowel, tanwin or sukun on each consonant, except the declared article/mater rules. Fatha/alif or alif maqsura, damma/waw and kasra/ya give long vowels; consonantal w/y with sukun remain diphthongal where applicable.
rules.consonants: Use the conventional Classical citation inventory, including j as /d͡ʒ/, emphatics /sˤ dˤ tˤ ðˤ/, gutturals /ħ ʕ/, and qaf /q/. This is not a reconstruction of early lateral dad or a modern dialect.
rules.gemination: Expand explicit shadda to two consonant segments. Never infer shadda from an unmarked spelling.
rules.article: At citation onset al-/wasl is /ʔal/ before moon letters; before sun letters omit l only with explicit sun-letter shadda. No connected-speech wasl deletion or invented vocalization.
rules.orthography: Handle explicit madda, dagger alif with fatha and final support alif after fathatan. Ta marbuta with an explicit ending is /t/ plus that ending; unmarked ta marbuta is unresolved and excluded. Unrecognized marks, boundaries and missing context are exclusions.
rules.validation: Converter candidates remain exploratory. No independently held-out Classical reference set or licensed Classical lexical snapshot is currently configured. The acquired IPA Dictionary Arabic snapshot is MSA and supplies no Classical fallback.

rules.stage: Use only the Wiktionary raw sound note 4th CE Koine, including its ordinal superscripts. Do not pool the 1st CE Egyptian inventory or later stages.
rules.vowels: Preserve the selected source convention: eta/ei/iota merger to /i/, omicron/omega to /o/, and upsilon/oi as /y/. No Attic phonemic vowel length is inferred.
rules.diphthongs: Preserve source ai /e/, ou /u/, and context-conditioned au/eu fricative realizations; do not regenerate Attic diphthongs.
rules.aspiration: The selected source uses phi /ɸ/, theta /θ/, chi /x/ (including palatal contexts) rather than Attic aspirated stops; rough-breathing h is not restored.
rules.consonants: Retain source beta/gamma/delta fricatives and context-dependent stop/nasal/palatal realizations. No modern f-for-phi substitution.
rules.stress: Source stress remains in original IPA evidence, but is removed from normalized segmental IPA under the shared feature-space policy. No Attic pitch accent is synthesized.
rules.gaps: Ancient/Classical Greek lemmas supply the lexical inventory. Unlabelled or wrong-stage readings are excluded; no spelling converter fills gaps.

rules.selection: Dictionary IPA first; retain source labels and unknown origins. No converter rescue or historical-convention claim; unresolved regional variation remains exploratory.
Dictionary IPA first; prior Epitran exclusions are baseline observations, not exclusions of new dictionary evidence. Preserve alternatives and source regional labels.
Audit the pinned bho code even when coverage is zero; no substitution of Hindi, invented pronunciation or assertion that all Bhojpuri dictionaries lack data.
Dictionary IPA first; old converter eligibility does not determine dictionary eligibility. Missing/unknown segments and regional variation remain explicit.
Dictionary IPA first; do not merge Hindustani/Urdu or transliterate joins automatically. Preserve alternatives and derivation uncertainty.
Dictionary IPA first, independently of the old converter panel; no unvalidated gap filling.
Dictionary IPA first; retain source dialect/script labels and unsupported tonal/segmental marks as diagnostics rather than discarding them.
Unspecified Romani dialect remains audit-only/exploratory. No pooling into a confirmatory dialect or reuse of restricted RomLex data as open dictionary evidence.
Dictionary IPA first; CDSL remains a lexical join target, not an independent pronunciation reference. Script-mismatched joins stay unmatched rather than guessed.
Dictionary-first modern Persian bridge; reject Classical/Dari labels and unverified IPA Dictionary entry kinds. No alphabetic/lexical fallback silently supplies vowels.
Dictionary-first Iranian bridge inventory; preserve regional alternatives and unknown derivation. No assumed modern converter validation.
Use dictionary IPA before any Epitran fallback; Zemberek stems are join targets only. Old held-out review status is not transferred.
Use dictionary IPA before any Epitran fallback; Magyar Ispell entries are join targets only. Old converter failures do not exclude dictionary data.
